sources.title: Key Republicans seek briefing from Nvidia CEO over Chinese spy allegations-document

stories.headline: US lawmakers request Nvidia briefing
stories.body: Reuters reported that three House committee chairs requested a closed-door November 18 briefing from Jensen Huang in a November 4 letter concerning China-related allegations. Nvidia said customer discussions do not involve national-security-sensitive secrets. Allegations are not findings.
stories.analysis: A request for a briefing is not a regulatory sanction or proof of wrongdoing.
stories.watch_next: Whether the briefing occurs and official findings emerge.
